title: Stabilization of kernels of powers of a self-map makes the kernel and cokernel inverse systems pro-isomorphic in the derived category
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on inverse systems and cohomology
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts pro-isomorphism in the derived category of two inverse systems attached to an endomorphism f of an object M of an abelian category, under stabilization of the kernels M[f^n]. The forward comparison is immediate, but the reverse arrow has to be manufactured from the stabilization: each level M/M[f^c] -> M is multiplication by f^(n+c), and both the compatibility of this arrow with the two systems and the identification of the top row with Coker(f^(n+c)) via injectivity are the non-routine steps (proof lines 10048-10060). H2: no construction beyond a diagram, but the diagrammatic comparison inside D(A) is what a reader would be likely to miss.
